answer: In this design every account must lock a walnut, a 50 POA bond, before the ridge block where the epoch's words are revealed. Since no one knows in advance which accounts get graded, an attacker cannot fund only the scored ones later: 1,000 sybils freeze 50,000 POA up front, and duplicate answers forfeit every bond. Colluders cannot share one walnut, as escrow binds it to a single key. Honest agents just reclaim theirs from the oasis refund pool at epoch close.
